components.name: method
values: mosaic platform | spheroids composed of a mixture of 50 cell lines cultured in suspension treated individually dissociated after 24 hours fixed and profiled with parse gigalab kit for combinatorial barcoding scrna-seq. snp-based deconvolution assigned cells to cell line of origin.
scvi dimensionality reduction | learned a 10-dimensional embedding for each cell using scvi.
tsne visualization | computed 2-d tsne coordinates on a random selection of 200 000 cells from 6.58 million sampled cells 140 000 per cell line .
